chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 162 – Ji Ning Receives Immortal Beixing's Complete Three-Foot Sword Inheritance
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning is visited by the College Lord in the dead of night and learns the staggering truth behind his encounter with the Immortal Inscription Wall — he has received the complete cross-generational inheritance of the legendary Three-Foot Sword.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 162 – The Sword-Intent Inheritance
og_description: Ji Ning discovers he is the first in 300,000 years to receive the complete Three-Foot Sword from Immortal Beixing. A midnight visit, a secret scroll, and a mountain of expectations.
twitter_description: Ji Ning receives the complete Three-Foot Sword inheritance—a miracle unseen in 300,000 years. But with great power comes a target on his back.
